q: Plant disease may also reduce yield and quality of ____ product. (2025- Set 9)
e: Plant disease may also reduce yield and quality of harvested product.

q: A plant disease is usually defined as ____ growth and dysfunction of a plant. (2024-Set 3)
e: A plant disease is usually defined as abnormal growth and dysfunction of a plant.

q: Nematodes are very tiny ____. (2024-Set 4)
e: Nematodes are very tiny roundworms.

q: The study of plant diseases is called plant ____. (2024-Set 2 ၊ နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: The study of plant diseases is called plant pathology.

q: Drought stress or ____ injury will likely cause damage on several types of plants. (2024-ရန်ကုန်နှင့်တိုင်းဒေသကြီးများတွင်မေး)
e: Drought stress or physical injury will likely cause damage on several types of plants.

q: Signs of plant disease are ____ evidence of the pathogen. (2025- Set 3)
e: Signs of plant disease are physical evidence of the pathogen.

q: Ringspots are characterized by the appearance of ____ or necrotic rings on the leaves. (2026- နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: Ringspots are characterized by the appearance of chlorotic or necrotic rings on the leaves.

q: All plants are attacked by one species or another of ____ fungi. (2025- Set 4)
e: All plants are attacked by one species or another of phytopathogenic fungi.

q: The parasitic organism that causes a disease is a ____. (2025- Set 13)
e: The parasitic organism that causes a disease is a pathogen.

q: Plant parasitic nematodes have a ____, a piercing mouthpart. (2025- Set 12)
e: Plant parasitic nematodes have a stylet, a piercing mouthpart.

q: Plant parasitic ____ have a stylet, a piercing mouthpart. (2024-နောက်ဆက်တွဲမေးခွန်း/ 2025-Set 8)
e: Plant parasitic nematodes have a stylet, a piercing mouthpart.

q: The hardening of arteries, caused by atheroma, is called ____. (2026- Set 1)
e: The hardening of arteries, caused by atheroma, is called atherosclerosis.

q: Anticoagulants are a class of ____ used to reduce blood clotting. (2026- Set 2)
e: Anticoagulants are a class of medicines used to reduce blood clotting.

q: Viruses are ____ pathogenic particles that infect other living organisms. (2025- Set 7)
e: Viruses are intracellular pathogenic particles that infect other living organisms.

q: Most cardiovascular disease starts with ____ formation. (2024-Set 2 / 2025-Set 9)
e: Most cardiovascular disease starts with atheroma formation.

q: Oxygen is supplied to the heart muscle by the ____ arteries. (2025- Set 6,11)
e: Oxygen is supplied to the heart muscle by the coronary arteries.

q: Taking regular exercise helps to control blood pressure and ____ level. (2025- Set 10)
e: Taking regular exercise helps to control blood pressure and cholesterol level.

q: Anticoagulants are a class of medicines used to reduce ____ clotting. (2025- Set 5)
e: Anticoagulants are a class of medicines used to reduce blood clotting.

q: Platelet inhibitory drugs such as aspirin are also a type of ____. (2025- Set 2)
e: Platelet inhibitory drugs such as aspirin are also a type of anticoagulant.

q: The death rate from different diseases is referred to as ____. (2025- Set 1)
e: The death rate from different diseases is referred to as mortality.

q: The antibiotic ____ is also used as a prophylactic drug. (2025- Set 4)
e: The antibiotic doxycycline is also used as a prophylactic drug.

q: Quinine and ____ are anti-malarial drugs used to treat infected people. (2026-နိုင်ငံခြား)
e: Quinine and chloroquine are anti-malarial drugs used to treat infected people.
